vehicleCounts.note: Directional measurement totals are already aggregated over detectors. No sum across counters; no imputed or missing values. Annual same-weekday/hour means, not live counts or forecasts. Public source may revise past observations.
vehicleCounts.ranking: Counts are point observations with incomplete street coverage. Street-context ranking is retained; absent counters are never treated as zero traffic.
